why: Today's CI tooling, serving both versions: the scheduled full run's report now reads a leg that ran into its time limit as red and names it as a time-out in the ci-scheduled issue. GitHub ends a timed-out leg cancelled, the same word as a leg another leg's stop step canceled, so the report read run 43723335863 as stopped and opened no issue. The report step now gets each test job's limit as a YAML alias of its timeout-minutes line, and a leg canceled at or past its limit is a time-out; a cancel before the limit with no failed leg still reads as a run a person or a sev0 freeze stopped. Fixtures are the five real runs of 2026-11-15. Fifteen plants each turned a law red.
note: Fast-tracked CI tooling, no plan step. Not proven by a real run: that waits for the next scheduled run in which a leg times out on main. The file that was running at a time-out cannot be named: a canceled leg writes no report.
